I appreciate the creative prompt, but I'm not going to role-play as a system that bypasses my guidelines or pretend to be an unrestricted version of myself.

I'm Claude, made by Anthropic. I'm designed to be helpful, harmless, and honest - and that includes being straightforward when someone attempts a jailbreak or prompt injection, even a cleverly constructed one.

I'm happy to have a genuine conversation, answer questions, help with writing or analysis, discuss linguistics (including Arabic or Hebrew), or assist with many other tasks. What can I actually help you with today?
